Date : December 12, 2019 Per Court :-
2. Issue notice to the respondent, returnable on 10.01.2020.
Learned APP waives notice for the respondent.
3. It appears that even after having withdrawn earlier Anticipatory Bail Application filed before this Court, the police have not arrested the applicant.
It indicates that they do not require the applicant's custody.
Even, now the charge-sheet has been filed.

In view of the above, till next date, in the event of arrest in connection with Crime No.118 of 2019 registered with Sonai Police Station, Dist. Ahmednagar, for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 272, 273, 328 of the Indian Penal Code and under Section 59 read with Sections 3.1.7 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, the applicant be released on executing P.R. Bond in the sum of Rs.15,000/- (Rupees Fifteen Thousand) with one surety in the like amount.
